basic_info.description: Excellent Investment Opportunity!  Located in classic Nob Hill, this distinguished residential income apartment building spans approximately 11,386 square feet on a 4,852 square foot lot. The property is thoughtfully arranged into 14 units, comprising 3 studios, 1 one-bedroom, 9 two-bedrooms, and 1 three-bedroom unit, offering a versatile mix of living spaces. With 7 current vacancies, this property is ideal for maximizing your investment by updating the units and adjusting rents to current market rates. Coih-operated laundry. With its blend of historic charm and substantial space, this building presents a prime investment opportunity with significant rental income potential.
